title: Nadahup languages - Wikipedia
text: The Nadahup languages, also known as Makú (Macú) or Vaupés-Japurá, form a small language family in Brazil, Colombia, and Venezuela. The name Makú is pejorative, being derived from an Arawakan word meaning "without speech". Nadahup is an acronym of the constituent languages.
